notes.subject: di (sweet clods)
notes.rationale: מתקו 'be sweet' + רגבי 'clods': lumps of the valley sweet to the dead man — either soft burial soil, or (Akkadian reading) he sucks the valley's mud; KJV/JPS keep the literal sweetness, some read 'melt away'

notes.subject: imshokh (draw)
notes.rationale: ימשוך: 'draw after him' — endless processions follow him to the grave, or he draws everyone after him; rendered as 'tugu' (follow)

notes.subject: jateden tɛ yen
notes.rationale: מספר 'number': the crowd before him is beyond counting

translation: Baji ka buguriw bɛ ⟨di⟩ a ye, a kɔfɛ hadamadenw bɛɛ bɛ tugu, a ɲɛfɛ jateden tɛ yen.
